summary: Assess energy project cash flows, tariff risk and financing options. Practise model reviews and investment cases. Explore the course.
lede: Energy project bankability training helps developers, utility finance teams, advisers and lenders assess whether an energy proposal can support financing. Participants review spreadsheet cash-flow models, test tariff and offtaker assumptions with scenarios, and assess debt capacity, risk allocation and blended-finance options. This work supports investment committee decisions by clarifying downside findings, financing choices and evidence gaps, rather than addressing installation design.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course suits professionals who shape, assess or finance capital proposals for energy assets. It is designed for roles that need to explain project cash flows, allocation of risk and financing choices to decision-makers.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with energy project proposals, financial statements or project appraisal is recommended. You should be comfortable with basic spreadsheet use. No coding or programming is required.
topics: Project finance, appraisal & public investment management
